select egbp.collect_id, egbp.server_no, egbp.veh_id, egbp.collect_date, egbp.route_id, egbp.gps_x, egbp.gps_y, GV.COMPANY_ID, GV.PLATE_NO, EGBR.ROUTE_NM from bigdata.ext_ggspl_bus_periodicinfo egbp inner join ( select MAX(collect_date) as RCT_COLLECT_DATE, route_id , veh_id from bigdata.ext_ggspl_bus_periodicinfo group by ROUTE_ID, veh_id ) RCT_BUS on egbp.route_id = RCT_BUS.ROUTE_ID and egbp.veh_id = rct_bus.veh_id and egbp.collect_date = RCT_BUS.RCT_COLLECT_DATE LEFT JOIN BIGDATA.EXT_GGBIS_BUS_ROUTE EGBR ON egbp.ROUTE_ID = EGBR.ROUTE_ID LEFT JOIN BIGDATA.EXT_GGBIS_VEHICLE GV ON egbp.VEH_ID = GV.VEH_ID WHERE 1=1
AND EGBR.ROUTE_NM LIKE '%' || #{routeNm} || '%'
LIMIT 5 OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * 5

select count(*) from bigdata.ext_ggspl_bus_periodicinfo egbp inner join ( select MAX(collect_date) as RCT_COLLECT_DATE, route_id , veh_id from bigdata.ext_ggspl_bus_periodicinfo group by ROUTE_ID, veh_id ) RCT_BUS on egbp.route_id = RCT_BUS.ROUTE_ID and egbp.veh_id = rct_bus.veh_id and egbp.collect_date = RCT_BUS.RCT_COLLECT_DATE LEFT JOIN BIGDATA.EXT_GGBIS_BUS_ROUTE EGBR ON egbp.ROUTE_ID = EGBR.ROUTE_ID LEFT JOIN BIGDATA.EXT_GGBIS_VEHICLE GV ON egbp.VEH_ID = GV.VEH_ID WHERE 1=1
AND EGBR.ROUTE_NM LIKE '%' || #{routeNm} || '%'
